description: Adds a domain to the list of identities for your Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region and attempts to verify it.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1496.004 - Resource Hijacking: Cloud Service Hijacking

incidents.description: Threat Actors Using AWS WorkMail in Phishing Campaigns

securityImplications: Attackers might use VerifyDomainIdentity to register a domain they control as a sending identity in the victim's account, so phishing or spam is sent through the victim's SES or WorkMail infrastructure and reputation.
